acceptanceCriteria: With two or more divergent projections, the journal reader's refusal names the same path and the same code (INTENT_DIVERGED or JOURNAL_FORKED) on every run, chosen by a documented deterministic rule (for example the byte-smallest path).
A maintained test with at least two divergent projection files, repeated (e.g. -count=20), asserts the identical refusal path and code each run, and fails on the current map-order iteration.
No change to the refusal for a single divergent file or to the success path.
body: internal/tasks/journal/records.go (Reader.projections, about line 557) ranges over the `canonical` map and returns the first mismatch it meets. Go map iteration order is randomized, so with two or more divergent projection files the refusal names A.json on some runs and B.json on others, and the code can switch between INTENT_DIVERGED and JOURNAL_FORKED depending on which path is visited first. Read commands must be deterministic for identical stores. Reported by the rc.3 corvint-tasks performance lane on base origin/main 855077fc (observed on base code, not introduced by that lane); the map iteration was confirmed by reading the source at claude/rc3-batch-2. Fix: iterate in sorted path order (or collect all mismatches and report the first in canonical order).
